title: Demister Vessel
model_title: Demister Vessel (Mesh Pad + Vane Pack Mist Eliminator)

introduction.definition: A demister vessel removes fine liquid mist from gas. Droplets strike the wires of a knitted mesh pad, coalesce into larger drops and drain; a chevron vane pack catches what remains by repeated changes of direction. Clean gas leaves at the top.
introduction.summary: A demister vessel removes fine liquid mist from gas. Droplets hit the wires of a knitted mesh pad, merge into larger drops and drain away; a chevron vane pack after it uses changes of direction to catch remaining droplets. Clean, dry gas leaves at the top.

video_tutorials.title: Demister Vessel — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Demister Vessel.
A demister vessel removes fine liquid mist from gas.
Droplets strike the wires of a knitted mesh pad, coalesce into larger drops and drain; a chevron vane pack catches what remains by repeated changes of direction.
Clean gas leaves at the top.
Typical applications include compressor and turbine inlet protection; absorber/scrubber outlets; sulphuric acid plants; steam drums and evaporators.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Demister Vessel.
Monitor ΔP across pad.
Wash/clean pad.
Replace pad/vanes.
Watch for plugged pad: high δp. Common cause: solids, salts, polymers.
Watch for re-entrainment: liquid carry-over. Common cause: velocity too high.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
